about: Hiya, I'm Alex! I have worked in software for 7 years, including web fullstack, infrastructure, and mobile roles. I'm a huge people person, thriving in focussed, close-knit teams, and love solving complex problems. Right now I'm scaling up the UK's most popular golf membership scheme into Europe!
I'm looking to learn as much as I possibly can about software engineering and computer science. From front-end dev, to embedded software, to machine learning, I need to know it all!
When I'm not doing computer stuff you'll find me on some hill hiking, biking, or climbing.
